Key Features

Main-level primary suite with 5-piece bath, two walk-in closets, and private office
Raised ranch / raised walkout design — main level and full lower level
Forced air heating with high-efficiency furnace — matches your search filter
3-car attached garage (768 sqft, 24’4”×32’3”) with RV parking
Vaulted great room with stone fireplace and mountain views through arched windows
